passages.context: CCC 1950-1953 (Latin): the moral law as work of divine Wisdom (1950); 'Lex regula est agendi ab auctoritate competenti propter bonum commune promulgata ... Omnis lex in Lege aeterna suam primam et ultimam invenit veritatem', with 'Ordinatio rationis lex nominatur' cited from Leo XIII (1951); the expressions of the moral law: 'Lex aeterna, fons omnium legum in Deo; lex naturalis; Lex revelata Legem veterem Legemque continens novam seu evangelicam; tandem leges civiles et ecclesiasticae' (1952); its fullness and unity in Christ (1953). Extracted verbatim from the exact fetched response.
